title: Spend an evening at Alinea
description: At Alinea in Chicago, dinner unfolds as a sequence of carefully designed courses rather than a conventional menu. The Gallery, Salon, and Kitchen Table offer different ways to experience the restaurant’s experimental cooking and presentation. Arrive ready to notice texture, aroma, and surprise as much as flavor; the meal asks for your attention and gives you plenty to talk about afterward.
teaser: Try a multi-course dinner built around culinary surprise.
goodToKnow: Reservations may open about two months ahead; confirm the current booking window, format and any dietary needs.
whyItMightDelightYou: It is an evening for people who enjoy having their expectations of a meal gently overturned.
